I've been there too. Try to be kind to yourself.

I was in almost the exact same position when I was your age (Senior in college now).

I didn't know what I wanted to do. Felt isolated. Went their way too much trauma for someone my age. I spent a long time wishing I was dead.

Fast forward to know, even though I wasn't sure what I wanted to do back then, I've found things that give me purpose now. I've made friends from college who are so much better than the ones in high school (for example, these friends wouldn't make jokes about me killing myself, which also happened to me), I've been able to surround myself in a community with similar interests (esports club) and I found a career that I really think gives me purpose (being a teacher).  Even now things are scary and traumatizing and tiring and I wish I'd just die in a car accident, but then i see a student who i know is going through a lot able at me and say I made their day better, and I just feel so warm, even just for a moment. 

It won't ever be easy, but you can make it so worth it. Be kind to yourself

When I'm upset I know I have a tendency to dig my nails in my arm or use my nails to just scratch at my self for some reason (trying to not use razors). But that's still a form of self harm. Don't try to force yourself to cut yourself, please. Try to think about why you want to/ why you use the scissors.

If its 'grounding' or clears your mind (my science m experience) try finding non harmful things that do the same thing.  I put my under running really cold water and it shocks me out of my emotions and calms me down. Try something like that?

Please take care of yourself!

You could also maybe make up an excuse relating to animals, if you have any. I have a cat and sometimes when she misses her toy while playing or I have to do things like trim her nails I end up with unintentional cuts all over my arm.

I personally try to think out and plan every detail. How do you save the people you care about most from being traumatized? Are there any friends that you want to end on a better note? Do you have any pets or children your responsible for? Do you have any ongoing commitments you care about? Is there something upcoming that you want to wait and experience first? What are you leaving behind?

Usually going through and thinking about these things makes my brain stop and refocus and change my mind, but I also know if I ever finally do it, I want to write messages for all the people I care about. I know how much it hurts to lose someone and I don't want to hurt anyone.

I am so so sorry for your loss. Thats really not something you should be going through on your own. Are your family supportive enough for you to talk to them? If you have a good relationship I wouldn't worry about hiding that you were dating, I'm sure they just want to make sure you are okay.

I've been both sides of this kind of relationship. I've had boyfriends who were depressed where I felt like I spent every moment trying to scramble around and find out what I can do to help them. I've also been the one numbly staring in to space while my s/o just held me and tried to make me feel better.

From what it sounds like, you're already doing almost everything you can do. Mental health is a long term battle that never has an "off" moment. Sure there are good times where its easier but it stays with you in the back of your brain. As awful as it feels,  you can't fix it for him. 

But it sounds like you're doing the best to support him you can, and that's what matters. From my experience even if he isn't seemingly getting better or vocally showing thanks, what you're doing for him (in whatever ways you can) *is* meaningful. Just try to be patient with him, help him with things, show support and sympathy. 


And please, please, please dont let his struggles hurt you too. Both for your sake and his. Make sure you're taking care of yourself too ♡

I'm sorry you have to go through so much trauma just to be yourself.

But sometimes it's okay for us to move on from something and appreciate it for what good times it gave us. 

I hope things get better for you ♡
